comparison.objective: Latch and safely carry a toolbox versus adjust and commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Close two latches and transport a loaded hinged box versus hex-key alignment, collar rotation, counterholding, locking torque, and impact-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Both latches closed, toolbox safely placed on shelf, lid shut, tools retained versus two safe repeatable carriage stops with no drift.
comparison.reason: Latch closure and setting-lock retention are mechanically and functionally different. The toolbox record supplies explicit spill, tip, drop, and lid-opening failure conditions.
